_comment: Annotated example for crowdstrike_connector.py --config. CrowdStrike's real Falcon API base URL depends on your cloud region: api.crowdstrike.com (US-1), api.us-2.crowdstrike.com (US-2), api.eu-1.crowdstrike.com (EU-1), api.laggar.gcw.crowdstrike.com (US-GOV-1). Delete this _comment field (or leave it; it's ignored) before using.
name: crowdstrike-detects
_comment_auth: OAuth2 client-credentials -- create an API client in the Falcon console (Support and resources > API clients and keys) with the 'Detections: Read' scope. client_id_env/client_secret_env name ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES holding the real credentials; never put them in this file.
